summary: The Throne of Eternity is the heart of the Plane of Time. All timelines converge here, and the Eternal Chronarch presides over the cosmic order. Mortals who reach this place confront the ultimate temporal authority.
history: The Throne formed at the convergence point of all timelines.
The Eternal Chronarch arose as the guardian of cosmic chronology.
Only those who survive all five phases may stand before the Throne.
